settings.label: Service account key
settings.meaning: The app's own Drive: the service account's JSON key, signed into a short-lived access token. Leave it unset when every call uses a user's own token.
settings.whereToFind: Google Cloud console › IAM & Admin › Service accounts › the account › Keys › Add key › Create new key › JSON: the whole file, as one string. A service account has no storage of its own: add it to a shared drive (GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID), or set GOOGLE_DRIVE_IMPERSONATE. Use a separate service account and folder for test.

settings.label: Folder or shared drive
settings.meaning: Where uploads and new folders go when no parent is given: a folder's id, or a shared drive's id (which is also the id of its top-level folder).
settings.whereToFind: The last part of the folder's address in Drive: drive.google.com/drive/folders/<id>. Share the folder, or add the service account's email as a member of the shared drive, so it can add files there.

settings.label: Act as user
settings.meaning: Domain-wide delegation: the service account acts as this Google Workspace user (the token's sub claim), with that user's Drive and storage.
settings.whereToFind: A user's email address in the Workspace domain. A super administrator first authorizes the service account's numeric client ID, with the Drive scope, in the Admin console under Domain-wide delegation (Manage Domain Wide Delegation).

settings.label: Channel token
settings.meaning: Checks that a change notification came from a watch the app started. You choose it; it's sent to Google when the watch starts, and Google sends it back on every notification.
settings.whereToFind: Any long random string of your own, up to 256 characters: channels.start gives it to Google.

settings.label: OAuth client ID
settings.meaning: For the app's own OAuth flow, when each user connects their own Drive. This client doesn't read it: it takes the user's access token from the app.
settings.whereToFind: Google Cloud console › APIs & Services › Credentials › Create credentials › OAuth client ID (Web application).

settings.label: OAuth client secret
settings.meaning: For the app's own OAuth flow, with the client ID. This client doesn't read it.
settings.whereToFind: Google Cloud console › APIs & Services › Credentials › the OAuth client.

operations.name: auth.token
operations.purpose: Exchanges the service account's signed JWT (RS256; iss, scope, aud, iat, exp at most an hour later, and sub when acting as a user) for an access token, at POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token with grant_type urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer.

operations.name: files.list
operations.purpose: Lists files matching a query, a page at a time (nextPageToken).

operations.name: files.download
operations.purpose: Downloads a stored file's content (alt=media). Google Docs, Sheets and Slides have none: export them.

operations.name: files.export
operations.purpose: Exports a Google Doc, Sheet, Slides or Drawing in another format (PDF, CSV, ...), up to 10 MB.

operations.name: files.upload
operations.purpose: Uploads a file with its metadata: multipart up to 5 MB, a resumable session (started, then the content in one PUT) above that.

operations.name: folders.create
operations.purpose: Creates a folder (a file with the mimeType application/vnd.google-apps.folder).

operations.name: files.update
operations.purpose: Changes a file's metadata, or moves it (addParents, removeParents).

operations.name: files.trash
operations.purpose: Moves a file to the trash (files.update with trashed: true), where it can be restored.

operations.name: files.delete
operations.purpose: Deletes a file for good, skipping the trash.

operations.name: permissions.create
operations.purpose: Shares a file with a user, a group, a domain or anyone with the link.

operations.name: changes.getStartPageToken
operations.purpose: The page token for changes from now on: store it, and list changes since it later.

operations.name: changes.list
operations.purpose: Lists changes since a page token, a page at a time; the last page carries newStartPageToken.

operations.name: changes.watch
operations.purpose: Starts a push channel: Google posts to the app's address when anything changes, until the channel expires (at most a week).

operations.name: channels.stop
operations.purpose: Stops a push channel, by its id and resourceId.

signature.description: Drive's push notifications aren't signed. The X-Goog-Channel-Token header carries back the token the app set when it started the channel; compare it with the channel token in constant time. The body is empty: the channel and what happened are in the X-Goog-Channel-ID, X-Goog-Resource-ID, X-Goog-Resource-State, X-Goog-Message-Number, X-Goog-Changed and X-Goog-Channel-Expiration headers.

events.meaning: The channel was created (X-Goog-Message-Number 1). Nothing changed.
Something changed: list the changes since the stored page token.
